subject: GD Task 1 output - SVG chart design audit (Chart.js replaced)
body:
GD TASK 1: SVG CHART DESIGN AUDIT (adapted from Chart.js audit)
Note: MCM replaced Chart.js with custom SVG (buildChart(), index.html:458-590). Task adapted accordingly.
Date: 2026-02-22

ELEMENT-BY-ELEMENT AUDIT

1. FILL GRADIENT (url(#fdg+timestamp))
   Default left: linear gradient from rgba(255,255,255,0.01) to rgba(255,255,255,0.17). White/transparent.
   Judgment: KEEP as-is. White on dark (#161b22). Subtle depth cue. Not distracting. Kai benefit: neutral.

2. SCORE LINE (FA - First Attempt)
   stroke: rgba(255,255,255,0.52), stroke-width: 2.5
   Judgment: BORDERLINE. White at 52% opacity on dark is 5.4:1 contrast (passes AA). But opacity causes it to thin visually at low DPI screens. Recommendation: bump to rgba(255,255,255,0.7) for mobile.

3. RIB LINE (Run It Back - retake)
   stroke: rgba(63,185,80,0.65), stroke-dasharray: 5 4
   Judgment: KEEP. Green at 65% opacity vs #161b22 = ~4.2:1. Borderline. But this is a non-text graphical element, needs 3:1 per WCAG 1.4.11. PASS.

4. GRADE REFERENCE LINES (A/B/C)
   A line: rgba(63,185,80,0.65) green. B line: rgba(255,255,255,0.14). C line: rgba(255,255,255,0.10).
   Judgment: A line KEEP (intentional green = aspirational). B and C lines CONCERN - at 0.14 and 0.10 opacity, these are decorative only. They provide zero cognitive signal for Kai. Consider raising to 0.25 or removing.

5. GRADE LABELS (A, B, C text)
   A: fill rgba(63,185,80,1) - PASS.
   B: fill rgba(255,255,255,0.35) - 4.5:1 on #161b22 - borderline. At 10px font: FAIL for normal text threshold.
   C: fill rgba(255,255,255,0.28) - 3.5:1 on #161b22 - FAIL for normal text at 10px.
   Kai impact: Can Kai read the B and C grade labels? Probably yes in good light. Probably not on phone in bright sun.
   Recommendation: Raise B to rgba(255,255,255,0.55), C to rgba(255,255,255,0.42).

6. X-AXIS LABELS ('1st Test', 'Practice 1', etc.)
   font-size: 10px, fill: rgba(255,255,255,0.35). Same issue as C label.
   At 10px and 35% opacity: fails AA for normal text.
   Kai impact: These labels tell Kai WHICH test each point represents. If he cannot read them, the chart loses meaning.
   Recommendation: Raise to rgba(255,255,255,0.55) minimum. Prefer rgba(255,255,255,0.65).

7. SCORE LABELS (right edge: '87%', '100%', etc.)
   font-size: 12px, font-weight: 700, color #3FB950 (green) or #8B949E.
   Green at 12px bold: PASS (6.8:1). #8B949E at 12px bold: 5.62:1 PASS.
   Judgment: KEEP.

8. DOTS (FA circles)
   stroke: rgba(255,255,255,0.5), fill: #161b22. 4px radius = 8px diameter.
   Judgment: WCAG 2.5.8 touch target size: 44px minimum. Dots are informational, not interactive. Not a violation.
   Kai impact: Fine. Dots are data indicators only.

9. GREEN ACHIEVEMENT DOT (last dot when pct >= 93%)
   Triple-ring treatment: outer glow, middle ring, center dot. All green.
   Judgment: EXCELLENT for ADHD. This is a micro-reward mechanic. Instant visual celebration. Keep and amplify if needed.

10. LEGEND (First try / Run It Back)
    font-size: 11px, color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5). Same concern as x-axis labels.
    Kai impact: If Kai cannot read 'Run It Back' at 11px/0.5 opacity, he cannot distinguish the two lines.
    Recommendation: rgba(255,255,255,0.65) minimum.

11. aria-label on SVG
    'Score progress chart showing N tests' - present.
    Judgment: GOOD. Passes 1.1.1. But doesn't tell screen reader the actual scores. Enhancement: include score data in aria-label or add a visually-hidden table with the data.

SUMMARY OF CHANGES RECOMMENDED

Priority 1 (readability failures):
- B label: opacity 0.14 -> 0.25 on line, 0.35 -> 0.55 on text
- C label: opacity 0.10 -> 0.20 on line, 0.28 -> 0.42 on text
- X-axis labels: rgba 0.35 -> 0.55
- Legend text: rgba 0.5 -> 0.65

Priority 2 (enhancements):
- FA line: rgba 0.52 -> 0.70 (mobile DPI)
- aria-label: add score data for screen readers

No-change (confirmed correct):
- Green A line and A label
- Score labels (#3FB950, #8B949E)
- Achievement dot triple-ring treatment
- RIB line (passes WCAG 1.4.11 for non-text)
